published_by: BEIS (2016-2022) / DESNZ (2023-), 'Greenhouse gas reporting: conversion factors', one set per reporting year
what_this_is: THE PUBLISHED FACTOR, NOT A READING OF IT. Transmission and distribution losses for UK electricity, row 'T&D- UK electricity', total kgCO2e per kWh, each reporting year's own file. Added to the generation factor for electricity consumed; a separate line, never folded into it (canon v4 CO4).

basis.units: kgCO2e per kWh of electricity consumed
basis.year_key: the BEIS/DESNZ reporting year whose factor set states the value
basis.scope: T&D losses only; not generation, not well-to-tank

provenance_legend.transcribed: read from that year's official workbook on 2026-10-12 for docs/market_research/household_carbon_and_the_measures_that_save_it.md ('T&D losses by reporting year'), each year's gov.uk URL recorded there. 2021 and 2022 were recovered past an xlrd parsing fault and cross-checked against two to three official files each. Asserted as an equality by the year-keyed rate census.

r13_wall: Published conversion factors, transcribed blind to company results. No value here may be moved because a carbon figure looks wrong.
portability: One factor per reporting year. Another market supplies its own artefact behind the same loader.

source_check.publication: DESNZ, 'UK government conversion factors for company reporting of greenhouse gas emissions' (gov.uk collection; one factor set per reporting year)
source_check.how_to_recheck: GET https://www.gov.uk/api/content/government/collections/government-conversion-factors-for-company-reporting and read `public_updated_at`. A later value means a set was added or revised; DESNZ publishes a new year's set each June, which adds a year to this artefact rather than changing an old one. The token was read on 2026-10-12; the factor values themselves were read by the 2026-10-12 knowledge pass (see the legend).

checked_for_supersession.note: collection page date read from the gov.uk content API on 2026-10-05; the 2026 set (June 2026) is not yet transcribed and is a new year, not a revision of the years held.
